subject.title: build(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should OpenClaw accept this single Dependabot batch of fourteen updated GitHub Actions—including token-minting and Codex-agent actions—after source-level review of the exact immutable revisions?
rationale: The patch changes trusted code executed by privileged workflows; this is a repository security-boundary acceptance decision, not a mechanical source repair.

options.title: Review and land the exact pins
options.body: A workflow/security owner verifies the upstream action changes and allows merge after the final rebased head completes the relevant workflow evidence.

options.title: Split sensitive revisions
options.body: Keep low-risk setup and scan action bumps separate while reviewing token, publish, attestation, and Codex-action updates in narrower PRs.

options.title: Pause the batch
options.body: Close or defer this batch if OpenClaw does not want to accept the current set of third-party action revisions together.

recommendation.title: Review and land the exact pins
recommendation.body: A workflow/security owner verifies the upstream action changes and allows merge after the final rebased head completes the relevant workflow evidence.

likelyOwner.reason: A named owner could not be established from the supplied context without trustworthy current-main history access.
